integrity: The claim has a self-contained combinatorial proof and a reproducible standard-library exhaustive verifier. No independent scientific audit or external certification has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Exactly one wildcard, linear scattered subsequences, minimum-length hosts, and labeled alphabets are addressed; extra-symbol and multiple-wildcard hosts are outside scope.
Exhaustive tests cover finitely many alphabet sizes and pattern lengths; the proof handles all parameters.
Literature searches are finite and cannot rule out an unindexed equivalent specialization.
title: Boundary rigidity of shortest one-joker scattered-subsequence covers
